$$
\begin{aligned}\int {csc}^{2}⁡x\,\text{d}x & =-cot⁡x+C, \\ \int csc⁡xcot⁡x\,\text{d}x & =-csc⁡x+C.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}\int csc⁡x(9cot⁡x+7csc⁡x)\text{d}x & =\int (9csc⁡xcot⁡x+7{csc}^{2}⁡x)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\int 9csc⁡xcot⁡x\,\text{d}x+\int 7{csc}^{2}⁡x\,\text{d}x \\  & =9\int csc⁡xcot⁡x\,\text{d}x+7\int {csc}^{2}⁡x\,\text{d}x \\  & =9(-csc⁡x)+7(-cot⁡x)+C \\  & =-9csc⁡x-7cot⁡x+C.\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
